faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear all your doubts before starting.

q1.q: Is Fature Aqui certified by AT?
q1.a: Yes, our platform strictly complies with all rules required by the Mozambique Tax Authority. All generated invoices have legal and fiscal validity.

q2.q: Do I need to enter a credit card to test?
q2.a: No. We offer an initial free plan so you can test without commitment. After that, we are known as the cheapest and most complete invoicing system in Mozambique, accessible to any company.

q3.q: What types of documents can I issue in the system?
q3.a: Our enterprise system allows the issuance of Cash Sales (VD), Invoices, Receipts, Delivery and Transport Notes, and Credit/Debit Notes. All certified by AT.

q4.q: What happens if I exceed the invoices on the free plan?
q4.a: The system will alert you that you have reached the monthly limit. From then on, you can choose to upgrade to the Pro Plan to continue issuing unlimited documents.

q5.q: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
q5.a: Yes. We don't require any loyalty. If you are not satisfied or no longer need the system, you can cancel your plan renewal with just one click.

q6.a: Totally. We use cloud servers with end-to-end encryption and daily backups to ensure your financial information is always protected.
